flags.message: Input coverage limitation, not a missing-record failure: application.txt is marked truncated and ends within the district-court appendix before the complete Ninth Circuit order. The snapshot records three October 13 responses, while application-response.txt contains only the first (Puyallup School District), consistent with the manifest's first-response selection rule. The forecast uses both available parties' accounts of the appellate ruling and does not purport to have read the separate WIAA or state responses.
